office_does: The auditor runs Benton County's elections and handles recording of documents, county accounting and vehicle licensing.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Brenda Chilton (Prefers Republican Party), auditor since 2010, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Benton County Auditor since 2010 and with the office since 1998; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Auditor since 2010; previously chief deputy auditor and office supervisor [S1]
Names election integrity and security among her top priorities and cites the new Benton County Elections Center [S1]
Endorsed by the Benton County Republican Party [S1]
